groupings.title: Setup and state
groupings.description: Bootstrap a repository and keep evidence-backed workflow state visible.

groupings.title: Design and plan
groupings.description: Close product requirements and turn them into executable feature or fix phases.

groupings.title: Execute
groupings.description: Implement one phase and fold frozen findings without widening scope.

groupings.title: Review and audit
groupings.description: Review a frozen design or a change, gate a PR, audit documentation, or inspect product health.

groupings.title: Internal review pack
groupings.description: Axis-specific reviewers composed by review-change and product-audit.

groupings.title: Decide
groupings.description: Verify and classify tracked work before changing the roadmap or code.

groupings.title: Documentation and session
groupings.description: Generate developer documentation and leave compact handoff records.

groupings.title: Autopilot and orchestration
groupings.description: Run the full roadmap or supply the driver-facing envelope contract.
